Hemoglobin 8.7 g/dL

Prothrombin time 15 seconds

Serum

Now, she's been brought to the ER by her daughter because of increasing arthralgia (joint pain), headache, and somnolence (excessive sleepiness) over the past week. Her vital signs are: temperature 38.6°C (101.5°F), which is a low-grade fever; pulse 80/min, which is normal; respirations 21/min, also within normal range; and blood pressure 129/80 mm Hg, which is slightly elevated but not too bad.
